### Idols, Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-august-25-2014.html
Passage: Genesis 35:1-4
Points:
- Good things turn into idols whenever they take the central place that belongs to God alone.
- Possessions, relationships, or achievements become sinful when they possess and control us.
- What we spend our time and resources on reveals where our true devotion lies.
- Believers must intentionally purge competing loyalties so Christ has first place in everything.

### Bible Pathways - Jan. 12, 2007
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-jan-12-2007-1463090.html
Passage: Genesis 35:1-3
Points:
- Outward material success is no guarantee that one is living in the will of God.
- In times of crisis and distress, believers must turn back to God in faith rather than despair.
- Spiritual renewal begins by putting away sinful habits and pursuing personal holiness.
- Returning to the Lord leads believers into heartfelt worship, remembrance, and thankful obedience.
